note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured, Zophar and Job are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent is shown (the iron weapon and bronze bow of verses 24-25 get no picture of their own). Picture ideas already used in Job 13-19 were avoided.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Stung by Job's rebuke, which he takes as an insult, Zophar is driven by his restless thoughts to answer at once.
ideas: In a living room a middle-aged man springs up out of his armchair, face flushed with offence, one hand raised and mouth open to answer at once, his cup tipping over on the side table
Late at night a man sits at his kitchen table under one lamp, unable to sleep, writing fast on a pad, crumpled drafts scattered round him
A kettle on a stove boiling over, its lid rattling and steam bursting out
A man pacing back and forth in a dark hallway at night, rubbing his forehead
A man lying awake in bed staring at the ceiling, jaw clenched
A man at a meeting table cutting in with a raised finger before the other has finished speaking
A man reading a letter, his face reddening, his other hand already reaching for a pen
A pan of milk rising and spilling over the edge on the stove
A man at a table of friends with his hand to his cheek as if he had been slapped
A runner bursting off the starting blocks before the gun

sections.meaning: From the very beginning the joy of the wicked has lasted only a moment: however high he rises, he vanishes like a dream, and the place where he stood sees him no more.
ideas: A single great firework bursting high in a night sky over a quiet town, its golden sparks already fading and falling
A huge soap bubble shimmering high above a park at the instant it bursts
At the top of a glass tower above the clouds a vast office stands empty, the leather chair turned to the window, two office workers in the doorway looking round for the man who sat there
A line of a man's footprints across wet sand that stops suddenly in the middle of the beach, with nothing beyond
A man in a suit with his arms raised in triumph on a skyscraper roof above the clouds
A tall sandcastle tower as the incoming wave washes it away
A sparkler in a hand burning down to its last spark
A man waking at dawn as a dream fades from his face
Breath fog on a cold window fading away
Morning mist burning off a lake until nothing is left

sections.meaning: What he took will be given back, by his sons to the poor and by his own hands, and he goes down to the dust still in his strength.
ideas: On the doorstep of a small worn house a young man in an expensive coat, head bowed, hands a thick envelope of money to an old woman who takes it unsmiling
Close view of a man's hands with a gold watch and rings pushing banknotes, gold coins and jewellery across a plain kitchen table into rough work-worn hands
Movers carrying a rich man's furniture into a poor family's small house
A young heir emptying his pockets onto a table before a judge
A strong young man's sports bag left on a bench in an empty gym
A rich man's son kneeling before a poor farmer to ask pardon
A wallet turned inside out, coins falling into an outstretched hand
Debt collectors carrying a television out of a fine house
A young man returning a stolen bicycle to a poor family's door
A cheque handed across a desk to a widow

sections.meaning: Wrongdoing tastes sweet to him and he keeps it hidden and savours it, but inside him it turns to poison, and the wealth he swallowed is thrown back up.
ideas: Alone at night in a dim rich study, a man in a fine suit closes his eyes in pleasure as a piece of dark chocolate melts on his tongue, the open gold box hidden behind his back
In an office at night a man smiles to himself as he slips banknotes from the cash box into his inside pocket, glancing at the door
At a lavish dinner table a man lifts a forkful of rich cake to his lips, eyes closed, while beside his plate a cobra rises out of the silver fruit bowl with its hood spread, unseen by him
A rich man doubled over at a lavish table, clutching his stomach in pain, his plate pushed away
A fat piggy bank turned upside down, all its coins pouring out
A man licking honey from a spoon while the shadow of a snake rises on the wall behind him
A shining red apple cut open, black and rotten inside
A glass of sparkling wine with a small snake coiled at the bottom
A man spitting a coin out into his hand, wincing
A man's sweet tooth: a pile of candy wrappers hidden in a drawer

sections.meaning: Because he crushed and abandoned the poor and seized a house he did not build, and his greed was never at rest, he will not enjoy what he got: he must give it back.
ideas: A man in a suit at the head of a long table heaped with honey cakes, cream and fruit; as he lifts his knife and fork, waiters lift every dish away from in front of him
Close view: a ringed hand reaches for a bowl of honey and cream, and another hand slides it away just out of reach
On a poor street a family stands on the pavement among their few belongings outside a small house, while on its step a man in a sharp suit locks the door and pockets the key without a look at them
Close view: a smooth hand with a gold cufflink takes a house key from an old work-worn hand that is slow to let go
A bulldozer pushing down a small house while the family watches
A man in a suit standing by a river of honey holding an empty spoon
A greedy man at a buffet with plates stacked high, still reaching for more
A man counting money in a shabby room he has taken over
An old couple's farm fenced off by a rich neighbour's new fence
A seized house left boarded up and falling apart

sections.meaning: At the very height of his plenty distress comes: God's anger rains down on him as his food, and running from one danger he is caught by another, with terrors upon him.
ideas: At an outdoor table laid with a feast a man in a suit raises his fork and looks up in shock as glowing red cinders rain out of a dark sky onto the table and his plate
A man in a fine suit sits at a feast with every plate full, his face grey with dread, staring at nothing, his fork dropped, unable to eat
A man running out the back of a mansion straight into the glare of waiting headlights
A man escaping over a fence into a yard where a guard dog waits
A wedding feast under a marquee as hail tears through the roof
A champagne glass shattering in a man's hand
A man in a suit running in terror across an open field at dusk
A man waking in a sweat in a luxurious bed, gripping the sheets
Lightning striking a golden statue in a garden
A storm cloud pouring rain onto one man's plate alone at a feast

sections.meaning: Darkness and a fire no one lit wait for the treasure he hid; heaven and earth expose his guilt, and all the goods of his house are carried off: this is the wicked man's portion from God.
ideas: At night in an empty field a man in a suit kneels pushing a heavy bag into a hole he has dug, pinned in a blinding searchlight beam from the sky; he throws up an arm, caught
In a dark basement vault stacked with gold bars and banknotes, small flames rise by themselves from the middle of the pile, with no one there
After heavy rain at dawn the soil of a field has washed away and split open, laying bare a buried strongbox full of gold and jewels
A heavy steel safe standing open in a dark room, its banknotes curling and blackening as flames rise inside it on their own
On a grey rainy day workmen carry a grand piano, gilt mirrors and paintings out of a mansion's front door to waiting lorries, the owner in a suit on the lawn watching it all go
Floodwater pouring out through the open front doors of a grand house, carrying chairs and paintings away down the drive
A grand house standing burned and black on a hill
A man's hiding place under the floorboards lifted and lit by a torch
The ground heaving up under a mansion, its walls cracking
A lawyer sliding a single sealed envelope across a bare desk to a man in a suit

scenes.principle: My anxious thoughts reply to me, because of my haste within me; I hear discipline that puts me to shame.
scenes.shows: A man springs up out of his armchair, face flushed with offence, hand raised and mouth open to answer at once, his cup tipping over.
scenes.prompt: In a plain, comfortable living room in the afternoon, a middle-aged man in a sweater springs up out of his armchair, his face flushed and offended, one hand raised and his mouth open to answer at once; the coffee cup on the side table beside him tips over as he rises. Across from him a worn grey-haired man sits on a sofa, seen from behind. The standing man's face and raised hand are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The cry of joy of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless man is for a moment.
scenes.shows: One great firework bursts high in the night sky over a dark town, its golden sparks already fading and falling.
scenes.prompt: High in a clear night sky over a quiet dark town, a single great firework bursts in a huge golden shower of sparks; the sparks are already fading and falling away into the dark. The burst fills the upper part of the picture; below lie dark rooftops and empty fields.

scenes.principle: Though his height goes up to the heavens, he will perish forever; those who saw him will say, 'Where is he?'
scenes.shows: At the top of a tower above the clouds a vast office stands empty, its chair turned to the window, two workers in the doorway looking round for him.
scenes.prompt: At the very top of a glass skyscraper that rises above the clouds, a vast, luxurious office stands empty: a wide bare desk, a tall leather chair standing empty and turned toward the window, and a sea of white clouds outside. In the doorway two office workers stand looking round the room, puzzled, as if asking where he has gone. The empty chair, the clouds and the two workers are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: His sons will appease the poor, and his hands will give back his riches.
scenes.shows: On the doorstep of a small worn house a young man in an expensive coat, head bowed, hands a thick envelope of money to an unsmiling old woman.
scenes.prompt: On the doorstep of a small, worn house in a poor street, a young man in an expensive dark coat stands with his head bowed in shame, holding out a thick envelope of money with both hands to an old woman in a cardigan at the door, who looks at him unsmiling. Their faces and the envelope are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Though evil is sweet in his mouth, though he conceals it under his tongue, spares it and does not abandon it,
scenes.shows: Alone at night in a dim study, a man in a fine suit savours a piece of chocolate with eyes closed and a secret smile, the gold box hidden behind his back.
scenes.prompt: Alone at night in a dim, richly panelled study, a man in a fine suit stands with his eyes closed in pleasure, letting a piece of dark chocolate melt on his tongue, a small secret smile on his face; with his other hand he holds an open gold box of chocolates hidden behind his back. His face and the box are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: His bread turns in his stomach; the gall of cobras is within him. He has swallowed wealth, and he will vomit it up.
scenes.shows: A man at a lavish table lifts rich cake to his mouth, eyes closed in pleasure, while a cobra rises with hood spread from the fruit bowl beside his plate, unseen.
scenes.prompt: At a lavish dinner table set with silver and candles, a man in a fine suit lifts a forkful of rich chocolate cake toward his open mouth, eyes closed in pleasure; right beside his plate a cobra has risen out of the silver fruit bowl with its hood spread, swaying, and he has not seen it. The man's face, the fork and the cobra are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Let him not look on the rivers of honey and curds. He gives back what he toiled for and will not swallow it.
scenes.shows: A man at the head of a laden table lifts his knife and fork just as waiters carry every dish away from in front of him.
scenes.prompt: A man in a fine suit sits at the head of a long banquet table heaped with honey cakes, bowls of cream, fruit and golden pastries; just as he lifts his knife and fork, waiters on both sides are lifting every dish up and carrying it away from in front of him, and he stares after them. The man and the dishes being taken are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: For he has crushed, he has abandoned the poor; he has seized a house.
scenes.shows: A poor family stands on the pavement among their few belongings while a man in a sharp suit locks the door of their small house and pockets the key.
scenes.prompt: On a grey morning in a poor street, a mother, a father and their two children stand on the pavement among their few belongings, a mattress, boxes and a lamp, outside the small house that was theirs. On its front step a man in a sharp expensive suit locks the door and pockets the key, not even looking at them. The family and the man are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: When his plenty is full, he will be in distress; he will rain the burning of his anger on him as his food.
scenes.shows: A man at a rich outdoor feast looks up in shock as glowing cinders rain out of a dark red sky onto the table and his plate.
scenes.prompt: At a long outdoor table laid with a rich feast on the terrace of a grand house, a man in a fine suit has just raised his fork and looks up in shock: out of a dark red sky, glowing red-hot cinders are raining down onto the table, into the dishes and onto his plate. The man's upturned face and the falling cinders are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: All darkness is hidden for what he has hidden away. The heavens will uncover his guilt.
scenes.shows: At night in a field a man in a suit, burying a heavy bag, is caught in a blinding searchlight beam from the sky and throws up his arm.
scenes.prompt: At night in an empty field, a man in an expensive suit kneels beside a hole he has dug, pushing a heavy bulging bag into it, when a blinding white searchlight beam shines straight down on him from the dark sky above; he throws up one arm against the light, caught in the open. The man and the beam are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The produce of his house will go into exile, poured away in the day of his anger.
scenes.shows: In the rain workmen carry a grand piano, mirrors and paintings out of a mansion to waiting lorries while the owner stands alone on the lawn watching.
scenes.prompt: On a grey rainy day, workmen in overalls carry a grand piano, gilded mirrors and framed paintings out of the front door of a mansion and down the steps to big waiting lorries, while the owner in a suit stands alone on the wet lawn in the rain, watching it all go. The workmen, the riches and the owner are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: Late at night a man sits wide awake and agitated at his kitchen table under one lamp, writing fast, crumpled pages all round him.
candidates.prompt: Late at night in a dark kitchen, a middle-aged man in a sweater sits hunched at the table under a single hanging lamp, wide awake and agitated, writing fast on a pad of paper; crumpled pages lie scattered across the table round him. His tense face and the lamp are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A huge soap bubble high above a park, caught at the instant it bursts.
candidates.prompt: A single huge soap bubble shimmering with rainbow colours floats high above a green park against a blue sky, caught at the very instant it bursts into a spray of tiny droplets. The bubble is in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.shows: A line of a man's footprints across a wet beach stops suddenly in the middle of the sand, with nothing beyond.
candidates.prompt: Seen from a low angle on a wide, empty, wet beach in soft grey morning light, a single line of a man's footprints crosses the sand and then simply stops in the middle of the beach, with smooth untouched sand all around and beyond the last print, as if he had flown away. The footprints and their sudden end are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A man's ringed hands push banknotes, gold coins and pearls across a kitchen table into rough work-worn hands.
candidates.prompt: Close view across a plain, scratched wooden kitchen table: a man's soft hands with a gold watch and heavy rings push stacks of banknotes, gold coins and a pearl necklace across the table toward a pair of rough, work-worn hands waiting open on the far side. The hands and the riches are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: In a dim office at night a man smiles to himself as he slips banknotes from an open cash box into his jacket, glancing at the door.
candidates.prompt: In a dim office at night, a man in a suit stands at a desk with an open metal cash box, smiling to himself with pleasure as he slips a fold of banknotes into the inside pocket of his jacket, glancing sideways at the closed door. His face and the money are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A man at a lavish table is doubled over in pain, clutching his stomach, his rich plate pushed away.
candidates.prompt: At a lavish dinner table set with silver, a man in a fine suit is doubled over in his chair in sudden pain, clutching his stomach with both arms, his face twisted and grey; his plate of rich food is pushed away and a wine glass has tipped over. The man are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A ringed hand reaches for a bowl of honey and cream, and another hand slides it away just out of reach.
candidates.prompt: Close view at a table laid with rich food: a man's hand with a heavy gold ring reaches for a glass bowl of honey and cream, and another person's hand is sliding the bowl away from him, just out of his reach. The two hands and the bowl are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A smooth hand with a gold cufflink takes an old house key from a frail, work-worn hand that is slow to let it go.
candidates.prompt: Close view in grey daylight: a smooth hand with a gold cufflink and an expensive watch takes an old house key from a frail, wrinkled, work-worn hand that is slow to let it go. Behind them, out of focus, stands a small old house. The two hands and the key are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: A man sits alone at a table full of rich food, not eating, his fork dropped, staring ahead grey with dread.
candidates.prompt: In a grand dining room a man in a fine suit sits alone at a table where every plate and dish is full of rich food, but he does not eat: his fork has dropped from his hand and he stares straight ahead with wide eyes, his face grey with dread. The man's face are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: In a dark vault stacked with gold and banknotes, flames start up by themselves in the middle of the pile, with no one there.
candidates.prompt: In a dark, windowless basement vault, shelves and floor are stacked with gold bars and bundles of banknotes, and in the middle of the pile small flames have started up all by themselves, with no one there to light them, the fire spreading in the dark. The pile and the flames are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.shows: Floodwater pours out of a grand house's open front doors, carrying gilded chairs and paintings away down the drive.
candidates.prompt: Muddy floodwater pours out through the wide-open front doors of a grand house and down its front steps, carrying gilded chairs, cushions and framed paintings away down the flooded drive. The doorway and the things being swept away are in the upper two thirds of the picture.
